title: 2002 HMMT February General Round 2 Problem 9
statement: \(A\) and \(B\) are two points on a circle with center \(O\), and \(C\) lies outside the circle, on ray \(A B\). Given that \(A B=24, B C=28, O A=15\), find \(O C\).

solutions.text: 41. Let \(M\) be the midpoint of \(A B\); then \(\triangle O M B\) is a right triangle with \(O B=15, M B=12\), so \(O M=9\). Now \(\triangle O M C\) is a right triangle with \(O M=9, M C=40\), so \(O C=41\).
